description: Product details by product or material id. Besides the UCP fields, metadata.configurator describes the chosen material: sizes, allowed quantities, options (attributes) with their values and default value, graphic services, production days. These are the inputs for price_configuration. For another material pass its id, or selected [{name: 'Materiale', label}] with a label from options: a label that matches no material returns an error listing the valid ones.
name: get_product
title: Product details
